description: This file defines the `RetrieveAclResponse` class, which models the response to a retrieve ACL (Access Control List) command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances from JSON, obtaining the ACL and related metadata, and handling JSON serialization/deserialization for API communication. The class extends a base command response class and implements interfaces specific to thing query commands.

classes.name: RetrieveAclResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a retrieve ACL command, encapsulating the ACL data, associated thing ID, HTTP status, headers, and JSON serialization logic. It supports construction from JSON and various factory methods for creating instances.
